abilities.transhuman-strategist: Grants 1 CP at the start of a battle round when Helbrecht is the selected Warlord.

abilities.high-marshal: At the start of the Fight phase, select one engaged enemy unit and roll D6: 1 causes 0 mortal wounds, 2-3 causes D3, 4-5 causes 3, and 6 causes D3+3. Uses shared mortal-wound prevention and allocation and resumes the phase-start window after allocation.
